question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable wake control plane in core now, including public CLI and operator-write Gateway APIs, before the predecessor stack has landed?
rationale: The implementation creates a substantial new core runtime, persisted-state, CLI, and public protocol surface; technical tests cannot decide whether that permanent product boundary and stack sequencing are desired.

options.title: Pause behind foundation gates
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer merge review until the predecessor durable PRs are explicitly sponsored and landed, then rebase and review this slice independently.

options.title: Sponsor the full stack now
options.body: Accept the durable-core direction and review the cumulative storage, runtime, protocol, upgrade, and operator-control design as one coordinated program.

options.title: Narrow to read-only inspection
options.body: Land only coordination and wake inspection first, leaving acknowledgement, supersession, and marking APIs for a separately approved mutation slice.

recommendation.title: Pause behind foundation gates
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but defer merge review until the predecessor durable PRs are explicitly sponsored and landed, then rebase and review this slice independently.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway control-plane history shows this person making the closest comparable core orchestration and authorization-surface decisions.
